talk.transcript: Today, I want to discuss the concept of ecosystem services. Ecosystem services refer to the benefits that humans derive from natural ecosystems. These services can be categorized into four main types: provisioning services, which include food and water; regulating services, such as flood and disease control; cultural services, which encompass recreational and spiritual benefits; and supporting services, like nutrient cycling and soil formation. Understanding these services is crucial for sustainable development and conservation efforts.

questions.explain: 生態系統服務是指人類從自然生態系統中獲得的好處。

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a type of ecosystem service?
questions.explain: 經濟服務不是生態系統服務的類型。

questions.q: What is an example of a provisioning service?
questions.explain: 食物和水是供應服務的例子。

questions.q: Why is understanding ecosystem services important?
questions.explain: 了解生態系統服務對於可持續發展和保護工作至關重要。
